the unreachable analyzer does not inspect or-handler bodies
inline variable on an or-handler initializer produces an oddly formatted edit
gon query refs reports references to the predeclared Result as unsupported; gon query type does not name the sub-kinds of ! (test Fatal, tuple to Result, Result to error)
no dedicated editor code action for test, tuple-to-Result or Result-to-error !; only the gonerrors suggestions and fixes exist

database/sql ScanStruct/Collect/CollectOne: mapping is strict (unmapped, ambiguous or duplicate columns are errors), tag comma options are reserved errors, RawBytes fields and element types are rejected; native pgx outside database/sql is not covered

! in test functions applies only in _test.go files when the nearest function neither returns error last nor exactly one Result and its first parameter is a named *testing.T, *testing.B, *testing.F or testing.TB; variadic first parameters and receivers do not qualify

tuple and Result bridging exists only at postfix !: a call ending in exactly error into a function returning one Result whose error type accepts error, and a Result whose error type is assignable to error into a function returning error last; no other implicit conversion
the errortest executable pair is not registered in cross_pair.sh, so wasm and Linux cross builds do not cover it
